decisions.reason: The LED track spotlight line sits squarely within the firm's track and modular system expertise, so feedback is easy to interpret and the line can be refined rather than withdrawn.
The flexible LED spotlight extends the firm's core spotlight know-how and was only launched in 2024, so management can still learn from early results and improve the line.
The multi-outlet ceiling canopy is a system accessory that builds on the firm's modular knowledge and supports the sale of its luminaires, giving it lasting value for the established business.
The low-voltage multi-outlet canopy draws on the firm's existing electrical and system expertise and complements its pendant and track offering, so it is easy to assimilate and maintain.

The round glass track luminaires fit the firm's design-led track competence, but their weaker presence on the website gives less market evidence than the other products, so their withdrawal risk is somewhat higher while keeping them remains the sensible choice.
